test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Realm
solution:
The correct answer is** "Sky."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Realm"** means a kingdom or domain. ((राजा या रानी द्वारा) शासित देश या राज्य; प्रभुता)

 
 
• **Example**: *The matter was hotly debated in all the towns of the **realm**__.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **realm** is something that is opposite in meaning, which is **sky**.
 
• **"Sky"** refers to the space above the earth where the sun, moon, stars and clouds are seen. (आकाश (ज़मीन पर से ऊपर की ओर दीखने वाला स्‍थान जहाँ सूर्य, चंद्रमा और तारे दिखाई देते हैं); आसमान)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The **sky**__ is blue.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 - Activity**: This is not an antonym of realm as both words are not related in meaning. (सक्रियता, क्रियाशीलता; गतिविधियों से पूर्ण स्थिति)
 
• **Option 3 - Kingdom**: This is a synonym of realm, not an antonym. (राजा या रानी द्वारा शासित देश; राज्‍य)
 
• **Option 4 - Domain**: This is also a synonym of realm, not an antonym. ((ज्ञान या कार्य का) क्षेत्र)
